comparison.objective: Hang a forklift fork on a carriage and slide it to set spacing; candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy-part lifting, hook engagement, and lateral sliding versus coaxial mandrel placement, bimanual hammering, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Fork hung and repositioned versus four notch fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage. Fork spacing tolerance is unspecified.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and outcomes differ meaningfully despite both involving bimanual manipulation.
